name: Visions of Duplicity — both targets are creatures you don't control; a pair with your own creature exchanges nothing
notes: "Exchange control of two target creatures you don't control." Before (2026-10-18) the controller words were read only for "target X and target Y" (exchangeSlotRules), so both lists held your own Grizzly Bears and a pair with it was exchanged. _exchangeControlSlotRules now gives both slots 'notYou' for "two target … you don't control".
